title: 期指走弱、芯片重挫，油价反弹；建行、中银香港与中创新航业绩待开盘验证 + 美股盘前：霍尔木兹推高油价，能源领涨；SAIC与GME获正反馈，长债压制科技
summary: 标普500、纳指100和道指期指延迟行情分别跌0.36%、0.47%和0.23%，WTI涨1.21%，美股现金时段半导体ETF跌3.47%、NVDA跌4.57%。Moomoo行业全榜因分页WAF未完成并按规则不输出行业行；Sparks正榜由体育博彩、零售和外卖领涨，可靠负榜缺失，以5个ETF压力样本披露。Futu OpenD未连接，A/H财报日历和公告检索降级；建行、中银香港与中创新航公开业绩等待周一正式价格反馈。 SPY、QQQ和DIA盘前分别约跌0.28%、0.20%和0.29%，USO涨3.44%、XLE涨1.72%，TLT跌0.44%。SAIC上调全年指引后盘前涨7.96%，GME初步利润改善后涨3.53%，NVDA涨0.62%并强于QQQ；AON以170亿美元现金收购USI后跌1.80%，仅作风险观察。今晚无可验证的大型科技财报样本。

关键词云图

芯片回撤期指降温原油反弹体育博彩云需求中银香港建设银行中创新航霍尔木兹行业榜缺口概念负榜缺口OpenD降级
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美军再度打击伊朗发射设施，霍尔木兹风险溢价回升
AP 8月30日报道，美国在霍尔木兹海峡附近打击伊朗火箭发射设施，为近一个月来首次新的美军行动；清雷推进但商业航运仍低迷。事实是军事行动重启，判断是油价、航运与避险资产的事件弹性上升，后续范围仍不确定。
国际
油轮在阿曼附近遇袭，美国筹划新一轮伊朗银行制裁
AP 8月30日报道，一艘油轮在阿曼哈萨卜以北遭不明飞行物击中；另据AP，美国准备针对伊朗银行体系的新制裁，中国仍是伊朗原油最大买家。事实是袭击与制裁压力并存，判断是能源供给和跨境结算风险继续影响A/H油运、石化与避险链。
科技
芯片成为周五最大科技异常，MRVL与NVDA领跌
周五SMH跌3.47%，MRVL跌10.28%、ARM跌6.33%、LRCX跌5.24%、NVDA跌4.57%，而纳指仅跌0.52%。MRVL毛利率指引低于一致预期是可验证触发之一；A/H半导体、设备、PCB和算力链需先防估值与拥挤度外溢。
科技
美股期指延迟行情全面走弱，纳指100期指跌幅居前
Investing.com页面显示9月标普500期指7694.00、-0.36%，纳指100期指29353.50、-0.47%，道指期指53463、-0.23%；页面行情时间约20:14—20:19 ET，08:42 CST抓取。广义风险信号偏空，但延迟数据不能替代开盘实时成交。
科技
Sparks消费服务偏强，可靠负榜以压力样本降级
Moomoo Sparks首屏正数Top5为体育博彩+2.97%、美国知名零售商+2.30%、外卖+2.30%、体育+2.25%、圣诞节概念+2.18%。完整分页与可靠负收益区未取得，面板仅用HACK、ARKK、SMH、BLOK、BITQ五个ETF压力样本，不能视为完整概念倒数榜。
科技
Amazon逆势上涨，AI算力需求与芯片抛售形成分化
AMZN周五涨3.97%，公开报道将其强势与AWS扩大英伟达芯片承诺联系；同期NVDA跌4.57%、SMH跌3.47%。A/H映射因此不是单向AI利好，而是云需求仍强、上游芯片交易拥挤度上升的结构分化。
财报
建设银行利润改善，净息差与资产质量保持韧性
建行8月28日公告上半年经营收入4263.33亿元、同比+10.48%，归母净利润1716.77亿元、同比+5.56%，净息差1.37%，不良率1.29%。未取得可比一致预期或正式前瞻指引，不能判定beat/miss；601939/00939周一开盘反馈待确认。
财报
中银香港盈利增长并提高中期股息
中银香港上半年股东应占溢利237.39亿港元、同比+7.1%，每股盈利2.2453港元，中期股息0.8188港元、上年同期0.58港元。未取得可比一致预期或正式前瞻指引，不能判定beat/miss；02388周一正式价格反馈待确认。
财报
中创新航收入与利润高增，电池链获本地观察样本
中创新航上半年收入270.8亿元、同比+65%，净利润15.2亿元、同比+102.2%，公司称增长来自客户、场景与产品拓展。未取得可比EPS一致预期或正式前瞻指引，不能判定beat/miss；03931开盘强度与成交才是验证。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
指数期指
Investing.com延迟行情：9月标普500期指-0.36%、纳指100期指-0.47%、道指期指-0.23%；对应页面行情时间约2026-08-30 20:14—20:19 ET，抓取时间2026-08-31 08:42 CST。三者是指数期货而非ETF代理，延迟字段已明确标注。
对照
板块对照
行业榜因分页WAF未完成，未输出行业代表股。概念正榜FLUT、AMZN、UBER、NKE及压力样本HACK、ARKK、SMH、BLOK、BITQ的当前夜盘逐股字段均不可得；AMZN重复出现仅计一次。故无法据个股判定确认、背离或潜在反转，只能用三大指数期指同步下跌作为广义风险降温信号。
映射
A/H 映射
周五美股芯片显著弱于大盘，期指继续偏弱，而WTI期货+1.21%，映射上偏向A/H油运、油气与高股息相对防御，芯片、PCB和高估值成长先看承接。开盘若恒生科技/科创板弱于大盘且芯片缩量，即确认压力；若放量收复前收，则构成潜在反转。

盘前结论

事实：三大美股期指延迟行情同步下跌，周五芯片ETF与NVDA显著回撤；WTI期货反弹，中银香港、建行与中创新航公布可验证业绩。Moomoo行业全榜与Sparks可靠负榜均未完整取得，不能从缺口推断行业广度。

判断：A/H基准情景偏向油运、油气、银行与高股息相对占优。芯片、PCB、机器人与高估值科技只在放量收复前收时升级，财报股必须服从正式开盘价格。

不确定性：霍尔木兹事件可快速改变油价；期指为延迟行情，个股夜盘字段不可得，OpenD财报检索亦降级。开盘前30分钟量价与相对指数强弱是最终验证。

重点个股推荐

中银香港
02388
股息与盈利

推荐理由：上半年股东应占溢利同比+7.1%，中期股息由0.58港元升至0.8188港元，银行防御属性较突出。

触发因素：开盘守住前收且强于恒生金融分类指数，成交较近期均值放大。

风险点：没有可比一致预期与正式指引，净息差和信用成本可能使headline与股价背离。

建设银行
00939
银行防御

推荐理由：经营收入同比+10.48%、归母净利润+5.56%，不良率1.29%，提供A/H银行的本地盈利支点。

触发因素：H股/A股均不失前收，且银行板块在弱期指环境中保持相对强势。

风险点：不能判定beat/miss；若利率曲线或房地产信用预期转弱，防御逻辑会受损。

中创新航
03931
电池业绩

推荐理由：上半年收入同比+65%、净利润+102.2%，客户与场景扩展为电池链提供业绩样本。

触发因素：开盘放量站上前收，并强于恒生综合行业中的同类成长股。

风险点：缺乏一致预期与前瞻指引，电池价格竞争、资本开支和高开兑现均可能压缩弹性。

中海油
00883
油价映射

推荐理由：WTI和Brent期货分别+1.21%和+1.14%，霍尔木兹风险支持上游油气相对防御。

触发因素：油价维持正收益，00883开盘强于恒指且不出现放量冲高回落。

风险点：地缘消息反转可快速压低风险溢价；油价已经包含部分供给担忧。

板块轮动看板

受益方向油运、油气、银行与高股息；油价反弹、期指走弱和本地银行业绩共同支持相对防御。
观察方向消费服务、云需求与电池；Sparks正榜和AMZN提供线索，但完整广度与个股夜盘不可得。
压力方向半导体、PCB、高估值科技、创新成长与加密链；现金时段与压力ETF均显弱。
验证信号恒生科技/科创板相对强弱，芯片能否收复前收，02388/00939/03931财报后价格，以及油价是否守住涨幅。

逻辑链

霍尔木兹军事与航运事件推升油价，同时Warsh偏鹰预期和芯片抛售压低成长风险偏好。
三大期指同步下跌确认广义风险降温；但个股夜盘字段不可得，不能对概念代表股做伪精确确认。
因此A/H先映射油气、油运、银行与高股息，本地财报只提供候选池，不代替价格反馈。
若科技指数放量收复前收则压力可能反转；若芯片继续弱于大盘而油价守强，则维持防御轮动。

风险雷达

地缘升级

美军行动、油轮遇袭或新制裁可进一步推升油价、运价和通胀预期。

芯片负反馈

MRVL、NVDA、ARM与LRCX同步下跌，A/H半导体可能出现估值与拥挤度外溢。

数据完整性

行业全榜、Sparks可靠负榜和个股夜盘均有缺口，面板已降级，不能外推缺失广度。

财报价格背离

建行、中银香港与中创新航均缺可比一致预期/正式指引，增长不等于股价必涨。

延迟行情

三大期指页面字段为延迟数据，若临近开盘显著反转，应以更实时价格覆盖本稿判断。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP（8月30日伊朗/霍尔木兹报道）；Investing.com（9月标普500、纳指100、道指期指及WTI、Brent、金银铜、10年期美债）；Moomoo行业页与Moomoo Sparks；公开美股收盘行情；建设银行、中银香港与中创新航公告。市场时间：美股现金数据为2026-08-28纽约收盘；期指页面行情时间约2026-08-30 20:14—20:19 ET，抓取时间2026-08-31 08:42 CST；页面更新时间2026-08-31 08:42 CST。Moomoo行业主页面仅得首30项、分页接口触发WAF/403，未完成145行业全榜，故行业组不输出排行行；Futunn首选Sparks页触发WAF，回退Moomoo Sparks首屏，可靠负收益区与完整分页未取得，5个ETF仅为压力样本。Futu OpenD 127.0.0.1:11111拒绝连接，HK/SH/SZ财报日历与“业绩公告/盈利预警/业绩快报/季度业绩”NOTICE检索均失败，已用公开公司公告降级，未启动OpenD。个股夜盘字段不可得；ETF仅为代理。

Keyword Cloud

Chip SelloffFutures CoolingOil ReboundSports BettingCloud DemandBOCHKCCBCALBHormuzIndustry GapConcept GapOpenD Degraded
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Global
US strikes Iranian launch sites as Hormuz risk premium rises
AP reported Aug. 30 that the US struck Iranian rocket-launch facilities near the Strait of Hormuz, its first new military action in almost a month. Mine clearing progressed but commercial traffic remained thin. The renewed action is fact; higher event sensitivity in oil, shipping and havens is the market inference, with scope still uncertain.
Global
Tanker is hit near Oman as Washington plans new Iran bank sanctions
AP reported that an unidentified projectile hit a tanker north of Khasab, Oman, and separately that Washington was preparing another Iran-bank sanctions push while China remained the largest buyer of Iranian crude. Attacks and sanctions are facts; continued sensitivity in A/H oil shipping, petrochemicals and havens is the inference.
Tech
Semiconductors deliver Friday’s largest tech anomaly as MRVL and NVDA fall
SMH lost 3.47%, MRVL 10.28%, ARM 6.33%, LRCX 5.24% and NVDA 4.57%, versus a 0.52% Nasdaq decline. MRVL’s gross-margin guidance below consensus was one verified trigger. A/H chips, equipment, PCBs and compute should first price valuation and crowding spillover risk.
Tech
Delayed US futures weaken broadly, led by Nasdaq 100 futures
Investing.com showed September S&P 500 futures at 7,694.00 (-0.36%), Nasdaq 100 futures at 29,353.50 (-0.47%) and Dow futures at 53,463 (-0.23%). Page market times were about 20:14–20:19 ET and the fetch was 08:42 CST. The broad signal is risk-off, but delayed data do not replace live opening trades.
Tech
Sparks consumer services lead; reliable negatives use disclosed samples
The first loaded Moomoo Sparks page had Sports Betting +2.97%, Top Retailers +2.30%, Food Delivery +2.30%, Sports +2.25% and Santa Rally +2.18% as positive Top5. Full pagination and reliable negatives were unavailable, so HACK, ARKK, SMH, BLOK and BITQ are disclosed ETF pressure samples, not a complete bottom ranking.
Tech
Amazon rises against the tape, splitting cloud demand from chip selling
AMZN gained 3.97%; public reporting linked the strength to a larger AWS commitment to Nvidia chips, while NVDA fell 4.57% and SMH 3.47%. The A/H read-through is therefore structural rather than uniformly bullish: cloud demand remains firm while upstream chip crowding has increased.
Earnings
CCB profit improves as margin and asset quality remain resilient
China Construction Bank reported first-half operating income of RMB426.333bn (+10.48%) and attributable profit of RMB171.677bn (+5.56%), with a 1.37% net interest margin and 1.29% NPL ratio. Comparable consensus and formal forward guidance were unavailable, so beat/miss cannot be judged; Monday feedback in 601939/00939 is pending.
Earnings
BOCHK grows profit and raises its interim dividend
BOC Hong Kong reported first-half attributable profit of HKD23.739bn (+7.1%), EPS of HKD2.2453 and an interim dividend of HKD0.8188 versus HKD0.58 a year earlier. Comparable consensus and formal forward guidance were unavailable, so beat/miss cannot be judged; Monday feedback in 02388 is pending.
Earnings
CALB posts strong revenue and profit growth, adding a battery-chain watch
CALB reported first-half revenue of RMB27.08bn (+65%) and net profit of RMB1.52bn (+102.2%), citing broader customers, use cases and products. Comparable EPS consensus and formal forward guidance were unavailable, so beat/miss cannot be judged; opening strength and turnover in 03931 are the validation.

US Overnight Summary

Overnight
Index Futures
Delayed Investing.com quotes: September S&P 500 futures -0.36%, Nasdaq 100 futures -0.47% and Dow futures -0.23%. Page market times were about Aug. 30, 2026, 20:14–20:19 ET, fetched Aug. 31 at 08:42 CST. These are index futures, not ETF proxies, and the delay is explicitly disclosed.
Cross-check
Panel Cross-check
The industry table was incomplete after a pagination WAF, so no industry representatives are published. Current overnight single-stock fields were unavailable for positive-concept representatives FLUT, AMZN, UBER and NKE and pressure samples HACK, ARKK, SMH, BLOK and BITQ; duplicate AMZN counts once. Stock-level confirmation, divergence or potential reversal cannot be classified, leaving only the broad risk-cooling signal from all three lower index futures.
Mapping
A/H Mapping
US chips materially underperformed Friday and futures remain weak, while WTI futures rose 1.21%. That maps defensively toward A/H oil shipping, energy and high-dividend names, while chips, PCBs and expensive growth must prove support. Weak HSTECH/STAR performance with thin chip turnover confirms pressure; a high-volume recovery above prior closes is a potential reversal.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: all three delayed US index futures were lower, while Friday’s chip ETF and NVDA fell sharply; WTI futures rebounded and BOCHK, CCB and CALB released verifiable results.The full Moomoo industry table and reliable Sparks negative range were incomplete, so missing breadth cannot be inferred.

View: the A/H base case favors relative defense in oil shipping, energy, banks and high dividend.Chips, PCBs, robotics and expensive tech upgrade only after reclaiming prior closes on volume; earnings names must follow actual opening prices.

Uncertainty: Hormuz events can quickly alter oil, futures are delayed, single-stock overnight fields were unavailable and OpenD earnings checks degraded. First-30-minute price-volume and relative-index strength are decisive.

Key Stock Setups

BOC Hong Kong
02388
Dividend & profit

Rationale: first-half attributable profit rose 7.1% and the interim dividend increased to HKD0.8188 from HKD0.58, supporting defensive bank exposure.

Trigger: hold the prior close, outperform Hang Seng financials and expand turnover versus recent norms.

Risk: comparable consensus and formal guidance were unavailable; margin and credit costs can make headline results diverge from price.

China Construction Bank
00939
Bank defense

Rationale: operating income rose 10.48%, attributable profit 5.56% and the NPL ratio was 1.29%, providing a local A/H bank earnings anchor.

Trigger: both H and A shares hold prior closes while banks preserve relative strength against weak futures.

Risk: beat/miss cannot be judged; weaker curve or property-credit expectations would erode the defensive case.

CALB
03931
Battery results

Rationale: first-half revenue rose 65% and profit 102.2%, giving the battery chain a strong local result sample.

Trigger: reclaim the prior close on volume and outperform comparable Hang Seng growth names.

Risk: no consensus or forward guidance was available; battery pricing, capex and gap realization can compress upside.

CNOOC
00883
Oil mapping

Rationale: WTI and Brent futures rose 1.21% and 1.14%, while Hormuz risk supports relative defense in upstream oil.

Trigger: oil retains gains and 00883 outperforms the Hang Seng without a high-volume gap-and-fade.

Risk: geopolitical reversal can quickly remove risk premium, and oil already discounts part of the supply concern.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesOil shipping, energy, banks and high dividend; rebounding oil, weaker futures and local bank results favor relative defense.
WatchConsumer services, cloud demand and batteries; Sparks positives and AMZN offer leads, but complete breadth and overnight single-stock fields were unavailable.
PressureSemiconductors, PCBs, expensive tech, innovation growth and crypto; both cash-session action and pressure ETFs were weak.
ValidationRelative HSTECH/STAR strength, chips reclaiming prior closes, post-results price in 02388/00939/03931 and whether oil holds gains.

Logic Chain

Hormuz military and shipping events lifted oil while hawkish Warsh expectations and chip selling reduced growth risk appetite.
All three index futures lower confirm broad cooling, but unavailable overnight single-stock fields prevent false-precision classifications for concept representatives.
The first A/H mapping therefore favors energy, oil shipping, banks and high dividend; local results create candidates but never replace price feedback.
A high-volume tech-index recovery above prior closes creates a potential reversal; continued chip underperformance with firm oil preserves defensive rotation.

Risk Radar

Geopolitical escalation

Further US action, tanker attacks or sanctions can lift oil, freight and inflation expectations.

Chip negative feedback

Synchronized losses in MRVL, NVDA, ARM and LRCX can spill valuation and crowding pressure into A/H semiconductors.

Data completeness

The full industry table, reliable Sparks negatives and overnight single-stock fields had gaps; the panel is degraded and missing breadth must not be inferred.

Earnings-price divergence

CCB, BOCHK and CALB lacked comparable consensus or formal guidance, so growth does not guarantee positive price action.

Delayed quotes

All three futures pages label their fields delayed; a material reversal near the open should supersede this brief.

Sources and Timestamps

Sources: AP (Aug. 30 Iran/Hormuz reports); Investing.com (September S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow futures plus WTI, Brent, gold, silver, copper and US 10-year yield); Moomoo industry page and Moomoo Sparks; public US closing quotes; CCB, BOCHK and CALB filings. Market time: US cash data are from the Aug. 28, 2026 New York close; futures page times were about Aug. 30, 20:14–20:19 ET, fetched Aug. 31 at 08:42 CST; page updated Aug. 31 at 08:42 CST. The Moomoo industry page returned only the first 30 items and pagination hit WAF/403, so the full 145-industry scan was not completed and the industry group publishes no ranking rows. The preferred Futunn Sparks page hit a WAF; the fallback Moomoo Sparks first page loaded, but reliable negatives and full pagination did not, so five ETFs are disclosed pressure samples only. Futu OpenD at 127.0.0.1:11111 refused connection; HK/SH/SZ earnings calendars and NOTICE searches for four required terms all failed, so public company filings were used as a downgrade and OpenD was not started. Overnight single-stock fields were unavailable; ETFs are proxies.

entries.title: 美股盘前：霍尔木兹推高油价，能源领涨；SAIC与GME获正反馈，长债压制科技
entries.summary: SPY、QQQ和DIA盘前分别约跌0.28%、0.20%和0.29%，USO涨3.44%、XLE涨1.72%，TLT跌0.44%。SAIC上调全年指引后盘前涨7.96%，GME初步利润改善后涨3.53%，NVDA涨0.62%并强于QQQ；AON以170亿美元现金收购USI后跌1.80%，仅作风险观察。今晚无可验证的大型科技财报样本。
entries.html:
关键资产图

SPY盘前代理
约-0.28% · 温和低开
QQQ盘前代理
约-0.20% · 科技偏弱
能源ETF XLE
约+1.72% · 领涨
原油ETF USO
约+3.44% · 通胀冲击
长债ETF TLT
约-0.44% · 利率压制
黄金ETF GLD
约-0.29% · 避险失灵

关键词云图

霍尔木兹能源领涨鹰派利率SAIC上调GME利润NVDA承接AON负反馈油价冲击长债走弱就业周加密回暖财报真空
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美军再度打击伊朗发射设施，霍尔木兹风险重回定价
AP 8月31日报道，美军周日打击霍尔木兹海峡附近的伊朗火箭发射设施，为约一个月来首次新军事行动。事实是冲突在短暂平静后再起；判断是能源、航运与通胀风险溢价上升，打击范围和后续报复仍不确定。
能源
原油跳涨逾3%，能源股成为最清晰的盘前正反馈
AP在美股开盘前记录Brent约91.10美元、涨3.4%，WTI约86.40美元、涨3.6%；Futu 20:38 CST数据显示USO盘前+3.44%、XLE +1.72%，XOM、CVX分别+2.10%、+2.33%。油价事实偏多能源股，但对大盘是通胀与利率压力。
期指
三大指数代理小幅走弱，能源与成长出现明显分化
Futu 20:38 CST显示SPY、QQQ、DIA盘前分别约-0.28%、-0.20%、-0.29%，IWM约-0.20%；AP稍早记录标普500与道指期货各跌0.2%、纳指期货跌0.1%。事实是风险偏好降温但非恐慌，开盘后油价与利率决定跌幅是否扩大。
政策
Warsh鹰派讲话抬高加息概率，短债收益率快速重定价
AP称两年期美债收益率由Warsh讲话前的4.22%升至4.35%；Reuters称9月加息隐含概率由约36%升至62%。这是长久期科技的估值逆风；政策路径仍取决于本周就业数据，不能把一次讲话视为确定加息。
资产
长债与黄金同时走弱，避险交易让位于通胀冲击
Futu显示TLT盘前-0.44%、GLD -0.29%；Reuters 10:30 GMT记录现货金约4448.19美元、跌0.1%，12月金期货跌0.7%，而白银涨1%。地缘升级未自动推高黄金，市场更在意鹰派利率与能源通胀。
科技
NVDA盘前转强，MediaTek合作与NVHBM路线提供边际催化
Futu行情显示NVDA盘前约+0.62%、成交约167万股，显著强于QQQ；Futu新闻流显示NVIDIA与MediaTek深化从AI边缘到云的计算合作，并披露可转债投资安排。价格反馈支持条件式看多，但周五曾跌4.57%，仍需开盘守住218美元附近。
财报
SAIC上调全年指引，盘前涨约7.96%
SAIC二季度营收18.80亿美元、同比+6%，调整后EPS 3.01美元；公司把FY2027营收指引升至72亿—73亿美元、调整后EPS升至10.65—10.75美元。Futu盘前价约135.99美元、成交约1.08万股，强价格反馈确认指引价值，但量能仍需开盘验证。
财报
GameStop初步利润改善，收入下降仍是结构性疑问
GME预计二季度销售7.80亿—8.00亿美元、低于上年9.722亿美元，但营业利润1.50亿—1.70亿美元、净利润2.90亿—3.10亿美元，均高于上年。盘前约+3.53%、成交约66万股；利润正反馈可交易，但其中约2.38亿美元来自eBay相关收益，质量与波动需折价。
并购
AON以170亿美元现金收购USI，市场先惩罚收购方
AON向SEC披露以170亿美元现金收购USI，交易仍需监管批准；Futu显示AON盘前约-1.80%、成交约1681股。按价格反馈规则仅列风险观察：现金支出、融资、整合成本、协同兑现与需求压力均可能压制估值，回避追多。
日历
今日数据清淡，但本周就业报告与加息定价仍是主线
纽约联储日历与Futu经济日历均显示今日主要事件为10:30 ET达拉斯联储制造业调查；AP提示本周将发布8月就业数据。当前低事件密度不代表低波动，油价、两年期收益率与就业预期仍可在开盘后放大指数振幅。

盘前结论

事实：指数代理仅小幅下跌，USO与XLE明显上行；SAIC、GME、NVDA获得盘前正反馈。AON收购消息对应负反馈，TLT与黄金未能提供传统避险缓冲。

判断：基准情景是能源与少数事件股相对强势，指数低开后震荡；科技不是全面利空，而是优先选择NVDA这类强于QQQ且有成交承接的标的。若油价继续上冲并推动两年期收益率创新高，成长股压力会扩大。

不确定性：地缘冲突、Warsh政策沟通与本周就业数据可能快速改变利率路径。开盘后15—30分钟以XLE相对强弱、QQQ能否收复盘前高点、NVDA/GME/SAIC缺口保持度为最终验证。

重点个股推荐

Science Applications International
SAIC
财报正反馈

推荐理由：上调FY2027营收、EBITDA与调整后EPS指引，盘前约涨7.96%，明显强于SPY；盘前成交约1.08万股，量能仍需开盘确认。

触发因素：开盘守住132美元上方、缺口保持过半并继续强于工业/国防服务同业。

风险点：季度调整后EPS同比下降、book-to-bill仅0.6；若电话会削弱订单能见度，缺口可能回补。

Chevron
CVX
油价映射

推荐理由：Brent/WTI跳涨逾3%，CVX盘前约+2.33%、成交约113万股，价格与量能均确认能源正反馈。

触发因素：WTI守住85美元、CVX维持强于XLE且开盘不出现放量冲高回落。

风险点：地缘缓和会快速挤出风险溢价；油价冲高也可能引发政策干预或需求担忧。

NVIDIA
NVDA
科技承接

推荐理由：周五大跌后盘前约+0.62%、成交约167万股，逆势强于QQQ；MediaTek合作消息提供边际催化。

触发因素：守住218美元并突破盘前高点219.31美元，同时半导体ETF不再扩大相对跌幅。

风险点：周五负反馈尚未完全修复，利率再升或AI拥挤交易继续去杠杆会使反弹失败。

GameStop
GME
初步业绩

推荐理由：初步营业利润与净利润高于上年，盘前约+3.53%、成交约66万股，市场给予明确正反馈。

触发因素：开盘守住18.20美元并在高波动中保留大部分缺口，成交继续扩张。

风险点：销售仍下降，净利润含大额eBay投资收益；公司交易与资本结构使波动率极高，只适合事件仓位。

板块轮动看板

强势观察能源、综合石油与炼化：XLE、CVX、XOM、OXY、VLO均获盘前正反馈，优先看油价守强与缺口保持。
事件驱动国防IT的SAIC、零售/投资事件的GME、AI合作催化的NVDA；只跟随价格确认，不把新闻标题当作买点。
压力方向长债、黄金及高久期成长；AON收购方负反馈只作观察/回避追多，等待止跌并评估融资与整合成本。
验证信号WTI能否守住85美元、两年期收益率是否再上冲、QQQ能否收复盘前高点，以及SAIC/GME/NVDA缺口保持度。

逻辑链

霍尔木兹军事行动重启，Brent/WTI跳涨逾3%，首先抬升能源股盈利弹性与通胀风险溢价。
Warsh鹰派沟通让两年期收益率升至4.35%，TLT与黄金同步走弱，说明市场交易的是利率冲击而非单纯避险。
指数代理仅小幅下跌，但XLE、CVX、SAIC、GME和NVDA相对走强，形成能源主线加少数事件股的窄轮动。
若油价守强而QQQ收复盘前高点，指数可震荡消化；若收益率再升且强势股缺口回补，则低开可能扩展为成长股主导的下跌。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足。Futu US财报日历、Kiplinger/Briefing.com周历及公开公司日历均未确认8月31日盘后有值得覆盖的大型科技公司；因此不虚构高/中/低概率，以下是已检查样本与信息限制。

高概率 · 无可验证样本没有同时具备明确盘后时点、科技属性、可比一致预期、历史surprise与近期卖方修正的公司。
中概率 · 无可验证样本Futu列出的SNLAY、CANG、PXS、GFASY等盘后候选不是大型科技公司，且EPS/收入预期多项缺失。
低概率 · 不强行覆盖小市值、ADR或时间口径冲突的样本不足以形成合规概率；信息不足本身不是低概率判断。
实际检查 · 日历结论Kiplinger明确称周一盘后无值得关注财报；Futu日历只见非科技/低覆盖样本。下一批重要科技财报集中在周二以后。

风险雷达

霍尔木兹升级

进一步军事行动、报复或航运中断会推高油价与通胀预期，并把温和低开转为更广泛风险回撤。

利率再定价

9月加息隐含概率快速升至约62%；两年期收益率继续上行将压制高久期科技与小盘股。

AON并购负反馈

170亿美元现金交易带来融资、现金支出、整合成本与协同不确定性；盘前下跌确认回避追多。

事件股缺口回补

SAIC、GME与NVDA若在前30分钟失守主要缺口或盘前支撑，推荐逻辑自动降级为观察。

初步数据与量能限制

GME数字尚未经审计，SAIC盘前量相对有限；盘前成交不能替代常规时段的价格发现。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP（8月31日美股期指、霍尔木兹、原油、利率与Bitcoin）；Reuters/MarketScreener（黄金、白银与FedWatch）；Futu OpenD实时QUOTE/盘前排行、财报与经济日历（SPY、QQQ、DIA、IWM、XLE、USO、TLT、GLD、SAIC、CVX、NVDA、GME、AON等）；SAIC业绩稿、GameStop投资者关系稿、AON向SEC提交的8-K；纽约联储经济日历；Kiplinger/Briefing.com财报周历。行情抓取约2026-08-31 20:38 CST（08:38 ET），页面更新2026-08-31 20:40 CST。Futu盘前排行榜脚本存在sort_dir类型错误，已直接调用同一OpenD接口取得榜单；个股量能为盘前累计值，财报时点与一致预期缺失处均已降级披露。
entries.html_en:
Key Asset Map

SPY premarket proxy
about -0.28% · mild gap down
QQQ premarket proxy
about -0.20% · tech soft
Energy ETF XLE
about +1.72% · leading
Oil ETF USO
about +3.44% · inflation shock
Long-bond ETF TLT
about -0.44% · rates pressure
Gold ETF GLD
about -0.29% · haven fails

Keyword Cloud

HormuzEnergy LeadsHawkish RatesSAIC RaiseGME ProfitNVDA SupportAON NegativeOil ShockLong Bonds FallJobs WeekCrypto WarmsEarnings Vacuum
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicates heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Global
US strikes Iranian launch sites as Hormuz risk returns to pricing
AP reported Aug. 31 that US forces struck Iranian rocket-launch facilities near the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, the first new military action in about a month. Renewed conflict is fact; higher energy, shipping and inflation risk premia are the market inference, while the scope of strikes and retaliation remains uncertain.
Energy
Oil jumps more than 3%, giving energy the clearest premarket confirmation
Before the US open, AP recorded Brent near $91.10 (+3.4%) and WTI near $86.40 (+3.6%). Futu at 20:38 CST showed USO +3.44%, XLE +1.72%, XOM +2.10% and CVX +2.33%. The oil move is positive for energy equities but an inflation and rates headwind for the broad market.
Futures
Major index proxies ease as energy and growth diverge
Futu at 20:38 CST showed SPY, QQQ and DIA down about 0.28%, 0.20% and 0.29% premarket, with IWM off about 0.20%. AP earlier recorded S&P 500 and Dow futures down 0.2% and Nasdaq futures down 0.1%. Risk appetite is cooler, not panicked; oil and rates will decide whether losses broaden after the open.
Policy
Warsh's hawkish speech lifts hike odds and reprices the front end
AP said the two-year Treasury yield rose to 4.35% from 4.22% before Warsh's speech; Reuters said implied odds of a September hike rose to about 62% from 36%. That is a valuation headwind for long-duration tech. The policy path still depends on this week's jobs data, so one speech is not a certain hike.
Assets
Long bonds and gold fall together as inflation shock displaces haven demand
Futu showed TLT -0.44% and GLD -0.29% premarket. Reuters at 10:30 GMT recorded spot gold near $4,448.19 (-0.1%), December gold futures -0.7% and silver +1%. Geopolitical escalation did not automatically lift gold because hawkish rates and energy inflation dominated.
Tech
NVDA strengthens as MediaTek collaboration and NVHBM add a marginal catalyst
Futu showed NVDA about +0.62% premarket on roughly 1.67 million shares, materially stronger than QQQ. Futu's news flow reported a deeper NVIDIA-MediaTek edge-to-cloud compute partnership and a convertible-note investment arrangement. Price action supports a conditional long, but Friday's 4.57% loss still requires support near $218.
Earnings
SAIC raises full-year guidance and gains about 7.96% premarket
SAIC reported second-quarter revenue of $1.880 billion (+6% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $3.01, then raised FY2027 revenue guidance to $7.2-$7.3 billion and adjusted EPS to $10.65-$10.75. Futu showed about $135.99 on roughly 10,800 premarket shares. Price confirms the guidance value, while volume still needs regular-session validation.
Earnings
GameStop's preliminary profit improves while falling sales remain structural
GME expects second-quarter sales of $780-$800 million versus $972.2 million a year ago, but operating income of $150-$170 million and net income of $290-$310 million, both above last year. Shares were about +3.53% on roughly 662,000 premarket shares. The profit response is tradable, but about $238 million of eBay-related gains lowers earnings quality.
M&A
AON agrees to buy USI for $17 billion in cash; the acquirer is punished first
AON disclosed to the SEC a $17 billion cash acquisition of USI, still subject to regulatory approvals. Futu showed AON about -1.80% premarket on roughly 1,681 shares. Under the price-feedback rule this is a risk watch only: cash outlay, financing, integration cost, synergy execution and demand pressure can all weigh on valuation, so avoid chasing.
Calendar
Today's calendar is light, but jobs data and hike pricing still drive the week
The New York Fed and Futu calendars both show the Dallas Fed manufacturing survey at 10:30 ET as today's main event; AP flags August jobs data later this week. Low event density is not low volatility because oil, the two-year yield and labor expectations can still amplify the open.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: index proxies are only modestly lower, while USO and XLE are sharply higher; SAIC, GME and NVDA have positive premarket feedback.AON's acquisition has negative feedback, and neither TLT nor gold is providing the usual haven cushion.

View: the base case is relative strength in energy and a small set of event stocks, with a lower open followed by range trading. Tech is not uniformly bearish; favor names such as NVDA that outperform QQQ with visible turnover.If oil extends and drives the two-year yield to a fresh high, growth pressure broadens.

Uncertainty: geopolitical conflict, Warsh policy communication and this week's jobs data can quickly change the rates path. In the first 15-30 minutes, use XLE relative strength, QQQ's ability to reclaim its premarket high, and gap retention in NVDA/GME/SAIC as the final validation.

Key Stock Setups

Science Applications International
SAIC
Earnings feedback

Rationale: SAIC raised FY2027 revenue, EBITDA and adjusted EPS guidance and gained about 7.96% premarket, far ahead of SPY. Premarket volume was roughly 10,800 shares and still needs opening confirmation.

Trigger: hold above $132, retain more than half the gap and continue to outperform industrial and defense-services peers.

Risk: quarterly adjusted EPS fell year over year and book-to-bill was only 0.6; weaker order visibility on the call could close the gap.

Chevron
CVX
Oil mapping

Rationale: Brent and WTI jumped more than 3%, while CVX gained about 2.33% premarket on roughly 1.13 million shares, confirming both price and volume.

Trigger: WTI holds $85, CVX remains stronger than XLE and the open avoids a high-volume gap-and-fade.

Risk: geopolitical easing can quickly remove the premium; an oil spike can also trigger policy intervention or demand concerns.

NVIDIA
NVDA
Tech support

Rationale: after Friday's sharp loss, NVDA gained about 0.62% premarket on roughly 1.67 million shares and outperformed QQQ; the MediaTek collaboration adds a marginal catalyst.

Trigger: hold $218 and clear the $219.31 premarket high while the semiconductor ETF stops widening its relative loss.

Risk: Friday's negative feedback is not fully repaired; higher yields or further deleveraging in crowded AI trades can end the rebound.

GameStop
GME
Preliminary results

Rationale: preliminary operating and net income topped last year, and shares gained about 3.53% premarket on roughly 662,000 shares, a clear positive response.

Trigger: hold $18.20, retain most of the gap despite high volatility and keep expanding turnover.

Risk: sales still declined and net income includes a large eBay investment gain; corporate transactions and capital structure make this suitable only for event-sized exposure.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative strengthEnergy, integrated oil and refiners: XLE, CVX, XOM, OXY and VLO all have positive premarket feedback; prioritize oil holding gains and gap retention.
Event-drivenDefense IT via SAIC, retail/investment events via GME and AI collaboration via NVDA; follow price confirmation, not headlines as entry signals.
PressureLong bonds, gold and long-duration growth. AON's buyer-side negative feedback is watch/avoid-chasing only pending a floor and a financing/integration-cost assessment.
ValidationWTI holding $85, the two-year yield's next move, QQQ reclaiming its premarket high and gap retention in SAIC, GME and NVDA.

Logic Chain

Renewed military action around Hormuz lifted Brent and WTI more than 3%, first raising earnings leverage for energy and the inflation risk premium.
Warsh's hawkish communication pushed the two-year yield to 4.35%, while TLT and gold weakened together, showing a rates shock rather than a simple haven trade.
Index proxies are only modestly lower, but XLE, CVX, SAIC, GME and NVDA outperform, producing a narrow rotation led by energy plus selected event stocks.
If oil holds and QQQ reclaims its premarket high, the indexes can digest the shock in a range; if yields rise again and strong gaps fade, the lower open can broaden into a growth-led decline.

After-close Earnings Beat Probability

There are not enough verifiable after-close technology reporters. The Futu US calendar, Kiplinger/Briefing.com weekly calendar and public company calendars did not confirm a large technology company worth covering after the Aug. 31 close, so no high/medium/low probability is fabricated. The checked samples and limits are below.

High probability · no verifiable sampleNo company combines a confirmed after-close time, technology classification, comparable consensus, historical surprise and recent sell-side revisions.
Medium probability · no verifiable sampleFutu's after-close candidates SNLAY, CANG, PXS and GFASY are not large technology companies, and several lack EPS or revenue estimates.
Low probability · no forced coverageSmall-cap, ADR or timing-conflicted samples cannot support a compliant probability; missing information is not itself a low-probability judgment.
Calendars checked · conclusionKiplinger explicitly lists no noteworthy Monday after-close reports; Futu only shows non-tech or thin-coverage samples. The next important technology reports cluster from Tuesday onward.

Risk Radar

Hormuz escalation

Further military action, retaliation or shipping disruption can lift oil and inflation expectations and turn a mild gap down into a broader risk selloff.

Rates repricing
